assumptions_challenged: MISEV2023 provides program-specific numerical assay acceptance criteria (LLOQ, precision, stability windows) applicable directly to SGL-001.
No relevant SGL-001 CMC/analytics or batch data exist (i.e., that MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, and GMP-like batch comparability are absent).
All required fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays (including stability-indicating potency assays linked to an in vivo PD endpoint) can be developed, validated, and packaged within a 3-month timeline.

Three GMP-like reproducible production runs with release/stability/potency demonstrating comparability can be executed and reported within the proposed timeline without prior unresolved process-development work.
Formulation/device compatibility for intact-EV recovery ex vivo/in vivo will be straightforward and will not require iterative optimization that extends timelines.
falsification_conditions: Program produces and submits MCB/WCB characterization and qualification reports demonstrating source-cell identity and master/working banks for SGL-001.
Fit-for-purpose validation reports are provided for intact-EV assays showing defined LLOQ, specificity, accuracy/precision, and robustness across required matrices.
A stability-indicating potency assay is developed and shown to correlate quantitatively with an in vivo PD endpoint in an orthogonal study (data and statistical correlation report submitted).

Three independent GMP-like production run reports are submitted, each with release results, defined specifications, stability data, and potency results demonstrating lot-to-lot comparability within pre-specified acceptance criteria.
Ex vivo and in vivo formulation/device compatibility studies are submitted showing intact-EV recovery with appropriate positive and negative controls and predefined acceptance criteria.
strongest_objection: The plan rests on interpreting MISEV2023 as a sufficient evidence base to mandate and to timebox specific program actions for SGL-001, but MISEV is a high-level consensus framework and does not demonstrate that SGL-001 lacks the cited CMC/assay/batch data nor supply program-specific numeric acceptance criteria or timelines; therefore the primary objection is that the proposed 3-month assemble/submit and gating expectations are not justified solely by the provided evidence and may be unachievable or premature without confirmation of existing program data and realistic assay development timelines.
